title: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
caption:
Your gut microbiome holds a record of your medical history. A new study reveals that common medications can leave lasting changes in your digestive bacteria years after you've stopped taking them.

Source: Sciencedaily - Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261120071501.htm
